verdict.rationale: First-party docs state kitty can be extended "with kittens using the Python language" and controlled from scripts, and show customizable kitten matching and actions (the hints kitten). A hands-on probe confirmed external scripting via `kitten @` remote control (ls, send-text, get-text, close-window), and community users praise the bundled diff and icat kittens. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the custom-kitten authoring API, hands-on or independent confirmation of writing a user-defined Python kitten.
